scope: Faithful Markdown editions of the two original historical briefs, including their user transcriptions and complete Claude collaboration records.
conversion_notes: Titles and subtitles extracted by the DOCX reader as metadata were restored to visible Markdown.
Section heading levels were adjusted beneath one document title; the vision's Claude exchange headings were made consistent under its collaboration appendix.
Historical status, cross-document links, compact navigation, and conversion notes were added outside the marked original document body.
Original prose, dates, proposal language, citations, tables, hyperlink targets, transcripts, and response wording were preserved without substantive edits or redactions.
Literal Markdown notation in the response appendices remains literal, matching its presentation in the Word documents; Markdown escaping is representational.
Whitespace and paragraph spacing were normalized by conversion. Word-specific pagination, running page numbers, font sizes, and table shading are not reproduced in GitHub Markdown.

Historical factual descriptions were not updated during conversion. The later vision supersedes the earlier conditional source-engine direction; preserved exploratory replies remain subject to their editorial corrections.
The source DOCX files are identified by filename, exact byte count, and SHA-256; the Markdown files are also hashed for this conversion snapshot.

verification.visible_text: DOCX body text, including titles, tables, and appendices, equals the Markdown round-trip text after whitespace normalization.
verification.tables_and_links: All table contents and all external hyperlink targets match the source documents.
verification.public_content_review: Targeted credential-pattern scan and content review found no credential material or unrelated private operational details. Intended author attribution, user transcription, Base12 context, and collaboration records were retained.
